title: 5 MINUTES POWERFUL MORNING PRAYERS TO COVER YOUR DAY WITH THE BLOOD
text: Lift your hands wherever you are. Just lift your hands. Father, we thank you. We thank you for this moment. We thank you for the gift of breath. We thank you that we are alive to see this day. Lord, we do not take it for granted. >> [music] >> Every morning that we wake up is evidence of mercy. It is evidence that you are not done with us yet. So, we receive this day as a gift from your hands, and we present it back to you as an offering. Have your way, Lord. Have your way in the name of Jesus. You may be seated. Before we go any further, I want to ask you please share this message. Share it right now before you even go further into it. You don't know who is waiting for this word. You don't know whose life is hanging on the edge of a breakthrough, and this message might be the turning point. God will use you as an instrument. He will use your hand, your phone, your platform. Just share it. One click, one forward, and watch what the Lord will do through your obedience. Now, let us minister. There is a truth that most believers know in their heads, but have never walked in with their lives. And [music] it is this, every day is a battlefield. Every single morning you wake up, you are stepping into territory. You are stepping into time that has spiritual dimensions. You are stepping into hours that have been contested by principalities, by powers, by the rulers of the darkness of this world. And if you do not understand this, you will live your days carelessly. You will walk through divine appointments and never recognize them. You will pass through open doors and never step in. You will face arrows you didn't cover yourself against. But there is a mystery that the spirit of God is releasing today. A mystery that has always been in the word, but it is time for the church to walk in it. The mystery is this, the blood of Jesus Christ is not just a historical fact, it is a present reality. It is a living, speaking, [music] active substance in the realm of the spirit. The Bible says in Hebrews chapter 12 verse 24 that the blood of Jesus speaks better things than the blood of Abel. Write that down. Hebrews 12:24. The blood of Abel cried out for vengeance. It cried out from the ground, and God heard it. But the blood of Jesus speaks, and what does it speak? It speaks mercy. It speaks covering. It speaks access. It speaks redemption. It speaks preservation. Every time you plead the blood of Jesus over your day, you are not performing a ritual. You are activating a living voice in the realm of the spirit that speaks on your behalf. Are you hearing me? Listen carefully. There are dimensions to the blood of Jesus that the church has not fully walked in. Most believers only know the blood for salvation, and that is precious. That is foundational, but that is not all. The blood is your legal standing before heaven. The blood is your protection against the enemy. The blood is the basis upon which angels are dispatched. The blood is the substance that silences every accusation that Satan brings against you. The blood is your covenant seal. Revelation chapter 12:11. I want you to see it. It says, "And they overcame him by the blood of the lamb and by the word of their testimony." The blood is the first weapon of the overcomer. Not prayer alone. Not fasting alone. The blood of the lamb. So, when you wake up in the morning, before your feet touch the ground, before you open your phone, before you check your messages, cover yourself with the blood. Cover your family with the blood. Cover your day with the blood. Now, watch what I'm about to show you. Turn with me to Exodus chapter 12. Exodus 12. I want you to see the Passover, because in the Passover, God was not just rescuing Israel from Egypt. He was demonstrating a pattern. A pattern of divine preservation that finds its fullness in the blood of Jesus Christ. Exodus 12:12 and 13. God says, "For I will pass through the land of Egypt on that night, and will strike all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and beast. And against all the gods of Egypt, I will execute judgment. I am the Lord. Now, the blood shall be a sign for you on the houses where you are. And when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and the plague shall not be on you to destroy you when I strike the land of Egypt. When I see the blood, not when I see your performance. Not when I see your achievements. Not when I see your education. Not when I see your connections. When I see the blood. God is saying there is something about the blood that causes judgment to pass over. There is something about the blood that causes destruction to skip a house. There is something about the blood that makes a life, a family, a home untouchable. The Israelites didn't have to fight that night. They didn't have to strategize that night. All they had to do was apply the blood. And when the destroyer came, and he came, he didn't stop. He kept walking, but every door that had the blood, he could not enter. >> [music] >> I am speaking to someone today. You have been trying to fight battles in your own strength. You have been trying to outrun the enemy through hustle, through strategy, through human connections. And I'm not saying those things don't matter, but there is a covering that surpasses all of them, and that covering is the blood of Jesus Christ. Apply the blood over your day today. Apply the blood over your children. Apply the blood over your marriage. Apply the blood over your business. Apply the blood over your health. Apply the blood over every journey you will take this week. Apply the blood over every meeting you will walk into. Apply the blood over every contract, every opportunity, every relationship. The blood is not just for emergencies. The blood is for every morning. This is why the priests in the Old Testament, every single morning, without fail, they offered the morning sacrifice. Blood was shed every morning. It was not a suggestion. It was a covenant pattern. Every morning before Israel went into the world, blood was applied on their behalf. You are a priest. 1 Peter chapter 2:9 says you are a royal priesthood. That means you have priestly functions, and one of your priestly functions is to cover your day with the blood of the lamb. Are you tracking with me? Now, I want to preach this for a moment before we go into prayer, because I need you to understand this with revelation, not just information. The enemy walks in time. He does not just attack people, he attacks time. He sends confusion into your morning to ruin your day. He sends delays into your schedule to frustrate your divine appointments. >> [music] >> He plans accidents. He plans encounters with the wrong people. He plans sudden sicknesses, sudden bad news, all targeted at time, because your life is made up of days. And your destiny is accessed through days. Every day that passes is either a day you will gain ground, or a day the enemy gain ground in your life. This is why Psalm 91:5 and 6 says, "You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day, nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that lays waste at noonday." There are arrows that fly during the day. There are specific demonic assignments that are activated during the hours of your day, and they target specific people, specific destinies, specific families. They are not random. The enemy studies you. He knows your vulnerabilities. He knows your seasons. He knows when you are most exposed, and he sends his arrows precisely. But when the blood is applied, when you have covered your day with the blood of Jesus, every arrow becomes powerless. >> [music] >> The Bible says in Isaiah 54:17, "No weapon formed against you shall prosper." Not cannot be formed. It can be formed. The enemy can form weapons. He has the capacity, but they cannot prosper against a blood-covered life. Listen to this. The blood of Jesus is God's final answer to everything the enemy can do. Before the enemy can bring a case against you, the blood has already answered. Before he can file an accusation, the blood has already dismissed it. Before he can send a plague, the blood has already put a seal. The blood is always ahead of the enemy. This is what it means to walk in covenant. This is what it means to be blood-covered. Thus saith the spirit of God, there is someone under the sound of my voice right now, and for the past 3 months, your days have been going wrong from the morning. You wake up, and something always starts on a wrong note. It seems like there is a pattern of disruption in your mornings. An alarm that doesn't go off. A situation that creates frustration. A phone [music] call with bad news before noon, and the rest of your day spirals from there. The Lord says today, that pattern is broken. It is broken by the blood. There is a morning altar that has been set against your day, and I speak to that altar now. Catch fire in the name of Jesus. That pattern is broken today. Let us go into prayer now. I want you to pray with me. Don't just listen. Engage. Lift your voice. This is warfare. This is your priesthood in action. Father, we come before you right now in the name of Jesus Christ, your son. We come not on the basis of our righteousness. We come on the basis of the blood. The blood that was shed on Calvary. The blood that cried out mercy. The The that purchased our access, our redemption, our standing before you. We plead that blood now, Father. We apply it to this moment. We apply it to this day. Lord Jesus, we thank you for your blood. We thank you that your blood is still speaking. We thank you that your blood has never lost its power. What it did 2,000 years ago, it is still doing today. The power of the blood has not diminished. The efficacy of the blood has not expired. The authority of the blood is eternal. We thank you, Lord. Now, by faith, we take the blood of Jesus and we apply it. I speak to every spirit of death and darkness that has been assigned to this day. By the blood of Jesus, you are stopped. You cannot operate. You cannot manifest. The blood is against you. I speak to every demonic agenda programmed into the hours of this day. I destroy you now. By the blood of Jesus, by the fire of the Holy Ghost. Every satanic program for today is terminated right now. The day has been handed to God. The hours belong to the Lord. Father, [music] let your angels take charge. Let the ministering spirits go ahead of every person praying right now. Let them clear the path. Let them push back every enemy. Let them establish order in every step, in every decision, in every encounter of this day. I decree this day will not be wasted. This day will not be hijacked. This day will not be stolen. This day is ordained by God and it will fulfill its purpose. Every divine appointment of this day will be honored. Every door that God has opened will be walked through. Every instruction that the spirit gives today will be heard and obeyed. By the blood of Jesus. Now, pray for your family. Open your mouth and call them by name. Don't let me pray for them. You pray. >> [music] >> Father, I cover my family with the blood of Jesus right now. My husband, my wife, my children, my parents, I place the blood of Jesus over their lives today. Everywhere they go today, the blood goes with them. Every car they enter today is covered. Every road they travel is covered. Every building they enter is covered. Every person they encounter is covered. No weapon, no accident, no sudden evil, no spirit of infirmity shall touch them. The blood of Jesus is their covering. The blood of Jesus is their protection. The blood of Jesus is their life. I decree that no evil shall befall them. I decree that no plague shall come near their dwelling. I decree that every satanic ambush set against my family today is exposed and dismantled. The Lord shall preserve their going out and their coming in from this time forth and even forevermore. Psalm 121 verse 8. By the blood of Jesus. Now, I want to shift into something deeper. I want to deal with covenants. I want to deal with altars. Because one of the reasons many people's days keep going wrong is not circumstantial. It is covenantal. There are altars. There are covenants made by ancestors, by family lines that have legal right to operate in the lives of descendants. And until those covenants are broken by the blood, those altars keep speaking. Galatians chapter 3 verse 13. Christ has redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, "Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree." Jesus became a curse so that every curse over your life would be absorbed. Every generational curse, every covenantal curse, every curse spoken over your bloodline, Jesus took it. He absorbed it in his body. He paid the full price. But you must apply this redemption. You must enforce it. You must say, "I receive my redemption." I receive the benefits of what Jesus purchased. The enemy does not automatically surrender just because um Jesus paid the price. You must enforce the victory. This is spiritual warfare. This is what the church is called to do. Father, in the name of Jesus, I come against every covenant made on behalf of my life without my consent. Every covenant made by my ancestors with dark powers. Every blood covenant, every oath, every vow, every dedication made at shrines, at riverbanks, crossroads, at family altars, at cultural ceremonies, I renounce it now. I disown it now. I break it now by the blood of Jesus. The blood of Jesus is stronger than every covenantal blood that was used against me. The blood of Jesus speaks louder than every curse that was spoken over my lineage. The blood of Jesus dismantles every altar that was established for my destruction. >> [music] >> I decree every evil altar that carries my name today is destroyed. Every evil priest that is working against my life today, your power is broken. The fire of God locates your altar now and it burns it to the ground. The materials you are using, they are rendered powerless. The incantations you are making, they return to you void. The arrows you have released, they return to sender. I am blood covered. I am untouchable. I am redeemed by the blood of the lamb. Someone needs to shout right there. Let us deal with health now. Let us deal with the body because the enemy attacks the body. He sends infirmity. He sends sickness. He sends sudden disease. He sends symptoms that have no medical explanation. And some people have been living in a cycle of sickness and they don't understand why. Every time they get better, it comes back. Every time they think they are healed, another thing shows up. Because there is a spirit. There is a spirit of infirmity. And that spirit has legal access through a covenant or a curse or through an open door. But Luke 13 verse 11 through 13. Jesus saw a woman who had been bent over for 18 years. 18 years. And Jesus said, "Woman, you are loose from your infirmity." He didn't diagnose her medically. He identified her condition spiritually. He said she was bound by a spirit of infirmity. And when he spoke to the spirit, the woman was immediately made straight. I speak to every spirit of infirmity right now. I address you in the name of Jesus Christ, the son of the living God. Your legal access is destroyed by the blood. Your assignment is canceled. Every sickness, every disease, every chronic condition, every recording illness, receive the command of the Lord. Loose them and let them go. Father, let healing virtue flow now. Let the same power that raised Jesus from the dead quicken the mortal bodies of every person praying with us today. Let bones receive strength. Let lungs receive breath. Let blood cells be purified. Let every organ function at divine capacity. Let every medication work beyond its natural parameters. Let doctors give reports that they cannot explain medically. To that one who has been living with pain, chronic pain, pain in your joints, pain in your head, pain that wakes you up at night. I speak to that pain now. By the authority of the blood of Jesus, you are gone. You are gone. The body is the temple of the Holy Spirit and the spirit cannot dwell in a tormented temple. Receive your healing now in the name of Jesus. There is someone under the sound of my voice. You received the medical report recently and it shook you. Fear has been your companion since that day. And the enemy has been whispering worst-case scenarios into your mind. I want you to hear the Lord right now. Thus saith the Lord of hosts, do not be afraid of that report. >> [music] >> For I am the Lord your God who heals you. I am Jehovah Rapha. That condition you received the name for I know a greater name. And at the name of Jesus, that sickness must bow. You will not die. You will live and declare the works of the Lord. Psalm 118 verse 17. Write it down. [music] Declare it over yourself daily. You will not die. You will live. I cancel the death sentence in the name of Jesus. I cancel the premature death assignment. I speak life into that situation now. >> [music] >> The same God who spoke to dead bones in Ezekiel 37 and said, "Life." Is speaking to that report today. Life. In the name of Jesus, life. Now, let us deal with finances. Let us deal with the gates of economic breakthrough. Because the enemy is not just interested in your soul. He's interested in your resources. He knows that when God's people are financially empowered, the kingdom advances. So, he places financial barriers. He places economic curses. He places delays and frustrations over income, over investments, over businesses. Deuteronomy 28 verse 12 says, "The Lord will open to you his good treasure, the heavens, to give the rain to your land in its season, and to bless all the work of your hand. You shall lend to many nations, but you shall not borrow." This is God's original plan for you. Lending, not borrowing. Surplus, not lack. Heaven open over your finances. That is the covenant. >> [music] >> But Deuteronomy 28 verse 17 says, "Cursed shall be your basket and your kneading bowl." There is a curse that targets exactly where your income and your provision are stored. And many people have experienced this. Money comes in and something always takes it. Always. There is always an emergency, there is always a crisis, there is always a reason why the money doesn't stay. That is not natural. That is a curse on the basket. >> [music] >> Father, in the name of Jesus, I come against every financial curse right now. Every spirit of poverty, every spirit of lack, every spirit that makes money flee, I bind you now. Your access is terminated. Your assignment is broken. The blood of Jesus is on my finances. My basket is blessed. My store is blessed. My business is blessed. My salary is blessed. >> [music] >> My investments are blessed. I speak to closed financial gates open now. I speak to blocked income streams flow now. I speak to every divine idea, every business concept, every wealth strategy that God has ordained for my life, be released now. Come to me now by the blood of Jesus. I decree that this week, financial testimonies will unexpected provision. Doors that have been shut for months opening this week. Contracts that have been delayed signed this week. Opportunities that seem dead resurrecting this week. [music] Father, let the wealth of the sinner find its way into the hands of the righteous. >> [music] >> Proverbs 13:22, let the transfer happen. Let it happen for those praying with us today. Let them experience financial shifts that they cannot explain by their own effort. Let them trace it back to this moment of prayer. Let them say it happened after I covered my day with the blood. Now, let us deal with marriages. Let us deal with relationships because the enemy targets covenant. He targets what God has joined together. He sends strange spirits into homes. >> [music] >> He sends misunderstanding that makes a husband and wife who love each other become enemies. He sends coldness. He sends distance. [music] He sends third parties, people with evil intentions, people who are instruments of darkness, people who are assigned to destroy what God has built. Malachi chapter 2:14, God says, "The Lord has been witness between you and the wife of your youth with whom you have dealt treacherously." God is a witness in your marriage. He is not an outsider. He is present. He sees every conversation. He hears every prayer. And he is willing to intervene when you invite him. Father, I cover every marriage under the sound of this message with the blood of Jesus. Every home that is on the verge of collapse, let the blood speak preservation. Let the blood speak restoration. Every couple that has stopped communicating, let the spirit of God restore vulnerability, restore tenderness, restore love. Let what the enemy has stolen be returned. I speak to every strange spirit that has entered a marriage, leave now. By the blood of Jesus, you are exposed. You are evicted. You have no legal right in this covenant. >> [music] >> You cannot operate in a blood covered marriage. Leave now in the name of Jesus. To that man who has been on the edge of making a terrible decision in his marriage, the Lord says stop. The Lord says the cost is greater than you know. The Lord says come back. Come back to the covenant. Come back to what you built. Come back to your wife. Come back to your family. The Lord says, "I will heal what was broken. I will restore what was lost, but you must [music] come back." To that woman who has been carrying the weight of a difficult marriage alone, silently, without support, the Lord sees you. He sees every tear. He sees every night you have cried out and felt like heaven was silent. >> [music] >> The Lord says, "I am not silent. I am working. I am working things together. Do not give up. Do not surrender this marriage to the enemy." Stand. Cover your home with the blood. Stand. I decree that marriages are being preserved under this message. Homes are being restored. Families are being rebuilt. The enemy's plans against covenant homes are being dismantled by the blood of Jesus right now. There are women here, women who have been believing God for children, women who have been told medically that it is not possible, women who have gone through procedures, through treatments, through disappointments, through miscarriages. And the pain is so deep that it is hard to even pray about it anymore. I want you to hear the Lord now. The Lord who opened Hannah's womb. The Lord who opened Sarah's womb. The Lord who opened Elizabeth's womb. The Lord who is the same yesterday, today, and forever. Hebrews 13:8, thus saith the spirit of God, "Your womb is not closed in the eyes of heaven. The doctors have given a report, but I am the final authority. And over your body right now be opened. In the name of Jesus, be opened. Every blockage, every fibroid, every hormonal imbalance, every structural issue, receive the touch of the almighty now. I decree fruitfulness over your body. I decree that you shall carry. You shall carry and deliver. You shall stand in the delivery room and hold your miracle in your hands. The Lord says, "This is your season." And to the men, to the men who have been told that there is a deficiency, that there is a problem, the Lord is your creator. He made you. And what he made, he can restore. Receive restoration now in the name of Jesus. Receive restoration in your body. What was deficient, let it be replenished by the spirit of the living God. >> [music] >> I decree new babies are coming into families under this message. New babies, new joy, new testimonies. The womb is opening. The womb is opening. Let us deal with destiny. Let us deal with purpose because there are people who are alive but not living. They have a heartbeat but not a vision. >> [music] >> They are existing but not advancing. They have gifts. They have callings. They have potential that has been locked up either by fear, by wrong environments, by wrong associations, by the enemy's manipulation, by a word spoken over them in a dark moment that they have believed. Jeremiah 1:5, "Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you. Before you were born, I sanctified you. I ordained you a prophet to the nations." Your destiny is not an accident. Your life is not a mistake. God knew you before you were formed. He had a plan before you arrived. And every assignment the enemy has sent to interrupt that plan, to delay that plan, to steal that plan, I deal with it now. I speak to every spirit of stagnation be broken now. I speak to every spirit of limitation be broken now. I speak to every wrong label that was placed on someone's life, "You will never amount to anything. You are not smart enough. You are not good enough. You come from the wrong family. You don't have the right connections." I destroy every one of those labels in the name of Jesus. They are not your identity. Your identity is in Christ. Thus saith the Lord, there is a man under the sound of my voice who has been in the same place for 7 years. 7 years without movement, without promotion, without visible progress. And you have begun to question whether God even sees you. The Lord says, "I see you. I have seen every faithful day. I have seen every prayer you prayed in secret. I have seen every seed you sowed in tears." And the Lord says your season of harvest is here. It is not coming. It is here. What you have been waiting for is not 10 years away. It is at the door. Do not lose faith now. Do not walk away from the field now. The harvest is here. I decree advancement in the name of Jesus. I decree promotion that comes not from the east or from the west but from God. Psalm 75:6 and 7. God is promoting someone under this message right now. It is happening in the realm of the spirit. You will see it manifest in the natural this week. Let us deal with time. Let us deal with lost time because one of the enemy's coolest weapons is time theft. He steals years. He steals seasons. He causes people to be in the wrong places, making the wrong decisions for extended periods of time. And when they finally come to their senses, they look back and mourn the years that the locust has eaten. Joel chapter 2:25. But God is a God of restoration. And his restoration is not gradual. It is sudden. It is not partial. It is complete. When God restores, he restores with interest. He restores double for your trouble. Isaiah 61:7, Father, I speak restoration of time right now. I speak restoration of lost years. I speak restoration of wasted seasons. Every year that was stolen, every season that was hijacked, every opportunity that was missed because of the enemy's interference, I call for divine restoration now. Let God restore it. Let God compress time. Let God bring what should have taken years to come in days. Let God do a sovereign work. To that person who feels like they are too far behind, too old, too late, the Lord says, "You are not late in my calendar. My timing is not your timing. My ways are not your ways. >> [music] >> I can accomplish in 1 year what should take 10. I can open in 1 day what has been shut for a decade. I am not limited by your age. I am not limited by your circumstances. I am the God of suddenly and I am releasing a suddenly over your life today. Now, in this final moment of prayer, I want to cover the day. I want to pray over the hours ahead because we are morning people. We understand that how you start determines how you end and we are not going into this day empty-handed. We are going in blood covered. Father, I apply the blood of Jesus to every hour of this day. From this moment until midnight, every hour is covered, every hour is sanctioned, every hour is blessed. No devil, no darkness, no evil has access to these hours. The blood is on the doorpost of every hour. I cover every journey taken today on foot, in a car, [music] on a bus, on a motorcycle, on an airplane, on a boat, the blood of Jesus is the covering. No accident, no collision, no sudden calamity. The blood speaks protection over every mode of transportation under this message today. >> [music] >> I cover every conversation happening today, every meeting, every interview, every negotiation, every phone call, the blood of Jesus is present. Wisdom speaks, the right words come. Favor flows. Every door that needs to open opens. Every situation that needs to turn turns. I cover every workplace, every office, every market, every school, every hospital, every farm, wherever these hands will work today, the blood covers it. The work of their hands is blessed. Their labor is not in vain. Whatever they touch today, it prospers. >> [music] >> I cover every mind, every thought, every decision, every plan. The mind of Christ is operating. Confusion is not welcome here. Mental fog is not welcome here. The blood covers the mind. Clarity, focus, divine wisdom, heavenly intelligence, the spirit of counsel and might, Isaiah 11:2. I cover the spirit. Let no strange spirit gain access today. Let no defilement enter through the eyes, through the ears, through associations. Let the blood be a filter. Let only what God allows to enter enter. Let the spirit remain pure, remain sensitive, remain tuned to the frequency of heaven by the blood of Jesus. I want to speak some words of knowledge before we close because the spirit of God is moving right now and he wants to speak specifically. There is a person watching this right now. Your name begins with the letter E. You have been carrying a secret burden, something that nobody around you knows about and it has been eating at you. Fear has been your companion in this and you have been asking God, "Do you see this? Do you know about this?" The Lord says, "I know. I know everything. I know what happened. I know how it started. I know who is involved. I know how you feel." And the Lord says, "I am handling it. You do not need to carry it anymore. Give it to me. Give me the weight and watch how I turn this situation around in a way that will bring you testimony instead of shame." There is a young man, a young man who is about to make a major life decision. You are at a crossroads right now. Two paths before you and both of them seem reasonable and you have been praying and you haven't heard clearly. The Lord says, "The path on the left leads to delay and struggle. The path on the right, although it looks unconventional, although people around you will not understand it immediately, that is my path for you. Trust me. Step into it. I will confirm it with signs and I will be with you every step of the way." >> [music] >> There is a family, a family that has been marked by early death. Generation after generation, the men in this family die before 60 and it has been a source of fear and mourning. The Lord says, "That cycle ends today. That covenant is broken today. The blood of Jesus has been applied to your bloodline. The spirit of untimely death is evicted from your family line. From this generation forward, your men shall live long. Your men shall see old age. They shall die in peace, satisfied, surrounded by their children's children. The Lord has decreed it. It is done." There is a woman in a difficult situation with her in-laws, a woman who has tried everything to make peace, to be accepted, to be embraced and it keeps failing. Rejection keeps meeting you in that home. The Lord says you are fighting the wrong battle. This is not a natural battle. There is a spirit of rejection operating in that family and you cannot win it with better behavior. Pray. Cover your marriage with the blood. Cover your mother-in-law, your father-in-law, every sibling-in-law with the blood. When the blood is applied, the spirit loses its grip and what has been withheld from you, acceptance, belonging, peace, it will come. It will come supernaturally. There is a man who has been battling with a habit, a private habit, something you are ashamed of and you have promised God so many times that it is the last time and it hasn't been the last time. And shame has kept you from coming boldly to the throne of grace. The Lord says, "Come. Come today. The blood has not run out for you." Hebrews 4:16 says, "Let us come boldly to the throne of grace that we may obtain mercy and find grace to help in time of need." The blood is still speaking for you. Come out of hiding. Come out of shame. Come to the Father and this time do not come in your own strength. Come asking for the Holy Ghost to strengthen what is weak in you. Come asking for his power to do what your willpower cannot do and you will be free. You will be free. Now, let us close this in fire. >> [music] >> Father, we have come before you this morning. We have not come with empty hands. We have come with the blood of your son. We have applied the blood. We have spoken the blood. We have [music] activated the covering. We declare that this day belongs to you. This day is set apart. This day is ordained. Every person who has prayed with us today, their day is covered. Their family is covered. Their destiny is covered. Their finances are covered. Their health is covered. Their marriage is covered. Their children are covered. Their journey is covered by the blood of Jesus. I close every door the enemy was planning to use today. I close it by the blood. I lock it. I seal it in the name of Jesus. I open every door of favor, of blessing, of breakthrough, of grace that God has ordained for today. I open it by the blood. I unlock it. I declare it accessible in the name of Jesus. The siege is over. Whatever has been holding you is releasing you today. The siege is broken. You are stepping into open fields. You are stepping into spaces where your gift will be recognized, where your labor will be rewarded, where your prayers will be answered. Walk into favor today. You are not walking out into this world as an orphan. You are walking out as a blood covered, Holy Ghost filled, heaven connected son and daughter of the most high God. The Father goes before you. >> [music] >> The Spirit walks with you. The Son intercedes for you. Every member of the Trinity is involved in your day-to-day. You are not alone.
